mil3.3.12:2.2: Yathā mahārāja nagaraguttiko majjhe nagare singhāṭake nisinno passeyya puratthimadisato purisaṃ āgacchantaṃ, passeyya dakkhiṇadisato purisaṃ āgacchantaṃ, passeyya pacchimadisato purisaṃ āgacchantaṃ, passeyya uttaradisato purisaṃ āgacchantaṃ,
mil3.3.12:2.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yañ-ca puriso cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti,
mil3.3.12:2.4: yañ-ca sotena saddaṃ suṇāti taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti,
mil3.3.12:2.5: yañ-ca ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti,
mil3.3.12:2.6: yañ-ca jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti,
mil3.3.12:2.7: yañ-ca kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti, yañ-ca manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti taṃ viññāṇena vijānāti.
